name: Finland
note: Finnish national law: Laki edunvalvontavaltuutuksesta 648/2007, Laki holhoustoimesta 442/1999, Perintökaari 40/1965, Laki potilaan asemasta ja oikeuksista 785/1992 and Laki 101/2001 on medical use of organs and tissues.

citations.title: Valtuutuksen vahvistaminen
citations.quote: Holhousviranomaisen on valtuutetun hakemuksesta vahvistettava edunvalvontavaltuutus

citations.title: Edunvalvojan määrääminen täysi-ikäiselle
citations.quote: Tuomioistuin voi määrätä edunvalvojan täysi-ikäiselle, joka sairauden, henkisen toiminnan häiriintymisen, heikentyneen terveydentilan tai muun vastaavan syyn vuoksi on kykenemätön valvomaan etuaan

citations.title: Kuolinpesän osakkaat
citations.quote: Kuolinpesän osakkaita ovat perilliset ja yleisjälkisäädöksen saajat sekä eloonjäänyt puoliso.

citations.title: Pesän yhteishallinto
citations.quote: Osakasten tulee, milloin ei ... ole järjestetty erityistä kuolinpesän hallintoa, pesän selvittämistä varten yhteisesti hallita pesän omaisuutta

citations.title: Pesänselvittäjä ja testamentin toimeenpanija
citations.quote: Pesän osakkaan hakemuksesta oikeuden on päätettävä, että pesän omaisuus on luovutettava pesänselvittäjän hallintoon

citations.title: Potilaan itsemääräämisoikeus
citations.quote: Jos laillinen edustaja, lähiomainen tai muu läheinen kieltää hoidon antamisen ... potilasta on mahdollisuuksien mukaan hoidettava yhteisymmärryksessä

citations.cite: Laki ihmisen elimien, kudoksien ja solujen lääketieteellisestä käytöstä 101/2001 9 §
citations.title: Elimien irrottaminen kuolleelta
citations.quote: Kuolleen ihmisen elimiä, kudoksia ja soluja saadaan irrottaa, jos ei ole tiedossa tai jos ei ole syytä olettaa, että vainaja eläessään olisi vastustanut toimenpidettä.

roles.name: Edunvalvontavaltuutettu
roles.summary: A continuing power of attorney. It does not operate on signature: the guardianship authority must confirm it on the attorney's application, supported by a medical certificate.

assigned.event: Principal grants the authorisation in a written instrument

starts.event: When the guardianship authority confirms it on the attorney's application

ends.event: Death of the principal opens the estate to the osakkaat

nameEn.en: Attorney under a continuing power of attorney

citation.cite: Act on the Continuing Power of Attorney 648/2007 s 2 (amendments up to 1140/2019)
citation.title: Act on the Continuing Power of Attorney (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: By a continuing power of attorney, the granter may authorise an attorney to represent the granter in matters concerning his or her property

citation.cite: Act on the Continuing Power of Attorney 648/2007 s 1 (amendments up to 1140/2019)
citation.title: Act on the Continuing Power of Attorney (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: enter into force in the event that the granter becomes incapable of managing his or her affairs ... (continuing power of attorney).

roles.name: Edunvalvoja
roles.summary: A court may appoint a guardian for an adult who cannot look after their interests and whose affairs are not being handled adequately in any other way.

assigned.event: Court appoints where the adult cannot safeguard their interests

conditions: asiat eivät tule hoidetuiksi muulla tavoin

citation.cite: Guardianship Service Act 442/1999 s 4 (amendments up to 637/2022)
citation.title: Guardianship Service Act (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: The guardian of an adult is the person who a court or the guardianship authority has appointed as the adult's guardian.

citation.cite: Guardianship Service Act 442/1999 s 4 (amendments up to 637/2022)
citation.title: Guardianship Service Act (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: The guardian of an adult is the person who a court or the guardianship authority has appointed as the adult's guardian.

citation.cite: Guardianship Service Act 442/1999 s 1 (amendments up to 637/2022)
citation.title: Guardianship Service Act (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: The objective of the guardianship service is to oversee the rights and interests of persons who cannot manage their economic and financial affairs themselves

roles.name: Kuolinpesän osakas
roles.summary: The heirs, universal legatees and surviving spouse are the parties to the estate and, absent special administration, must administer it jointly.

assigned.event: By status as heir, universal legatee or surviving spouse

ends.event: Estate handed to a pesänselvittäjä, or wound up

transitions.event: Kuolema; osakkaat hallitsevat pesää yhteisesti (18 luku)

citation.cite: Code of Inheritance 40/1965 ch 18 s 1 (amendments up to 1228/2001)
citation.title: Code of Inheritance (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: The heirs, the universal beneficiaries under a testament and the surviving spouse shall be shareholders in the decedent's estate.

roles.name: Pesänselvittäjä
roles.summary: On an estate party's application the court orders the estate handed to an administrator and appoints someone to run it.

citation.title: Code of Inheritance (unofficial translation published on Finlex)

roles.summary: Someone appointed by will to administer the estate in place of the heirs and universal legatees; they too may apply for the administration order.

roles.name: Laillinen edustaja, lähiomainen tai muu läheinen
roles.summary: Where a patient cannot decide, the legal representative, a close relative or another person close to them is heard; if they refuse treatment the patient is to be treated by another acceptable means so far as possible.

assigned.event: By status as legal representative, close relative or other close person

starts.event: When the patient cannot decide on their own treatment

nameEn.en: Legal representative, close relative or other person closely connected with the patient

roles.name: Vainajan tahto elinluovutuksessa
roles.summary: Finland presumes consent: organs may be removed unless it is known, or there is reason to assume, that the deceased would have opposed it. An express prohibition in life is binding.

assigned.event: By law; the deceased's own position in life governs

ends.event: Removal carried out, or barred by the deceased's prohibition

nameEn.en: Wishes of the deceased in organ donation

citation.cite: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health, Presumed consent to be followed for organ transplants (press release, 23 August 2010)
citation.title: Presumed consent to be followed for organ transplants
citation.quote: This allows for the organ donation of a suitable deceased person to be used in the treatment of another individual

citation.cite: Act on the Medical Use of Human Organs, Tissues and Cells 101/2001 s 9a (653/2010)
citation.title: Act on the Medical Use of Human Organs, Tissues and Cells (unofficial translation published on Finlex)
citation.quote: The deceased person's near relative or other close person must be given an explanation of the removal of organs, tissues or cells

poaDurableByDefault.note: The edunvalvontavaltuutus is made for the grantor's future incapacity, but has no effect until confirmed.

poaRegistrationBeforeUse.note: The guardianship authority must confirm the authorisation on the attorney's application, with a medical certificate, before it can be used.

healthAgentStartsOn.note: The representative or close relative is consulted once the patient cannot decide on their own treatment.

organDonationModel.name: Laki 101/2001
organDonationModel.note: Removal is allowed unless it is known or there is reason to assume the deceased would have opposed it.
